issue.title: bug: TestFrameworkFinder can break tools resolution

selection.reason: A concrete open bug with no discussion or open implementation, not used to build Hunch PHP support, whose fix can give Infection direct value.

baseline.method: Issue text, AGENTS.md, source, tests, one analogous finder and Git history inspected with Git and ripgrep only.
baseline.diagnosis: TestFrameworkFinder prepends Composer's bin directory to the process-wide PATH before searching. The mutation persists after discovery, so unrelated later executable lookups and child processes inherit a different resolution order.
baseline.smallest_expected_fix: Pass the Composer bin directory as an explicit highest-priority search directory to test-framework discovery instead of mutating PATH. Preserve custom-path handling, the project-local-first lookup order, the Windows batch-file preference and the non-executable fallback.
baseline.regression_test: Resolve a test framework from the Composer bin directory while asserting that PATH is byte-for-byte unchanged after find().
baseline.scope_boundary: Do not refactor StaticAnalysisToolExecutableFinder or the wider command-runner design in this bug fix. Name the analogous side effect separately if it remains.
acceptance: The Composer-bin executable still wins over an executable available only through PATH.
PATH is unchanged after successful discovery.
The targeted TestFrameworkFinder test suite passes.
make cs and make autoreview pass before an upstream PR is proposed.
